ui_bugs.issue: STILL BROKEN / REGRESSED: <Redirect href='/'> in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:23 causes an infinite 'Maximum update depth exceeded' loop on sign-out because '/' is claimed by BOTH app/index.tsx and app/(tabs)/index.tsx. The replace('/') navigation never leaves the (tabs) group, so the layout re-renders, Redirect remounts and fires replace again -> forceStoreRerender loop -> page freeze. Round-trip sign-in could not even be attempted. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:23, /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:13-14

react_native_issues.issue: Expo Router <Redirect> inside a layout whose target path '/' is ambiguous (duplicate routes app/index.tsx and app/(tabs)/index.tsx) causes infinite navigation loop. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:23

action_items: CRITICAL: Remove the '/' route ambiguity - this is the root cause and the current fix (Redirect in tabs layout) made it worse. Recommended: move AuthScreen to a dedicated unique route, e.g. app/sign-in.tsx; then app/index.tsx becomes a pure dispatcher (if loading -> spinner; if user -> <Redirect href='/(tabs)' />; else <Redirect href='/sign-in' />) and app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx redirects to href='/sign-in' (a path claimed by exactly ONE route). Verify on web: sign out -> AuthScreen immediately, then sign in again on the same page load -> Home renders.
After fix, retest: sign-out must produce ZERO 'Maximum update depth exceeded' console errors and the page must remain interactive (no freeze).
VERIFIED OK (no action): Trainer role icon renders correctly; UI registration -> Home redirect -> Profile render works.

rca_of_issue: BUG: Sign-out freeze, REGRESSED from blank-screen to full crash loop. Repro: sign in (trainee.test@skillalign.in / Trainee@Test2026) -> Profile tab -> tap Sign out (logout-button). Observed: 587x 'Maximum update depth exceeded' errors within ~3.5s; stack: Redirect effect -> router.replace('/') -> linkTo -> navigation store forceStoreRerender -> layout re-render -> Redirect remount -> replace again. Root cause: href '/' is matched by TWO routes (app/index.tsx and app/(tabs)/index.tsx), so the router never settles outside the (tabs) group; the layout-level Redirect re-fires on every store rerender. Iteration_1 identified this ambiguity; the applied fix moved the Redirect into the layout without removing the ambiguity, converting a benign blank screen into a fatal render loop. Mitigation: give the auth screen its own unique path (e.g. /sign-in) and point all guards there; keep exactly one route claiming '/'.
